reviews.title: Personal trainer
reviews.text: It’s like having a personal trainer! This app is awesome

reviews.title: Best fitness plan
reviews.text: This app has taken me from awkward gym novice to confident gym gal. It tracks my effort, adjusts my plan, and keeps me focused. I highly recommend

reviews.title: Long Time User
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app off and on for about 12+ years. I could never find anything remotely close that offers what it does. The ability to track, build, and monitor progress is dope. Especially the ability to build my own workouts or specific exercises. I certainly like the example videos built in. The one thing I do hate is every time I switched I had to get the free version. Of course that’s when you could just pay for the app and be done. Now it’s on a subscription service.

reviews.title: Great app w progressive overload
reviews.text: This app has it all. Not only does it fit your needs but it takes injury, muscular and skeletal, including severity, into consideration. It tailors each workout and progression with a program to fit your personal progress or lack there of. I’m so glad someone told me about this app over 8 years ago. It’s that good!!
Not for the weak minded or weak hearted. Legit as legit gets

reviews.title: Full of AI bloat
reviews.text: Returned to the app after about 5 years and is totally unrecognizable. Constantly trying to tell me what exercises to do while pushing premium/AI features constantly. It is no longer the simple logging app that it used to be.

reviews.title: Great Guidance + Flexibility
reviews.text: It is a great app that helps you reach your goals while offering flexibility based on your available equipment and exercise preferences. It’s easy to swap an exercise for a different one that targets the same muscle groups. It’s very user-friendly and easy to follow.

reviews.title: Great but needs some non-ai refinement
reviews.text:
Best app for me just because it can adapt to a custom set of equipment and weights (I have an unusual set of free weight plates).

Love that it has a personalized plan that is adjustable to a decent degree. Love that it can take injuries into account when suggesting exercises.

I don’t like:
- the frequency of exercises that involve holding a heavy, awkward-to-grip weight right above my head. I always replace these in the loop because it is just absurdly dangerous.
- Inconsistent bodyweight exercises. It will sometimes give me a bodyweight exercise, but assign a nonsensical weight value to it (like 1 pound, or 60 pounds… I don’t weigh that much? And I can’t adjust my actual weight?)
- The weekly plan does not account for missed days. You cannot go back and complete an incomplete week. You cannot adjust the order of days. It just presses on without you and will increase intensity even if you are behind schedule. That is not adaptive.
- suggests a few exercises that are just silly for the sake of variety
- many of the above complaints relate to the incorporation of AI. Let humans with brains program your exercise modules.

reviews.title: Gym Switching in Adaptive Plans
reviews.text:
I love the app, I’ve been using it for over 10 years. The new updates are incredible and user-friendly, for the most part. 

Issue: I like using the adaptive plans, but I work out in two separate gyms with different equipment. 

Request: There needs to be a way to set the gym and the plan auto-updates to the equipment without restarting progress.  

Thank you

reviews.title: Hate the change
reviews.text: I hate with a passion the way they changed the input for sets and weight. It used to be so easy and now it's pretty much ruined. I get that you have a different vision for the  future but I don't see why you can't have a  toggle to allow people to input the way you used to with the reels. The Apple keyboard input is horrible and getting worse and it's nice not to have to type out the weight EVERY time.

reviews.title: Love this app!
reviews.text: Very easy to use & customize.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: Great app. Wish it could combine the measurements of LBS and miles. Depending on the gym you got KG, LBS, KM, Miles. And I always gotta change either before or during the workout the unit of measure on the settings section.

reviews.title: This App Gets Worse With Every Update
reviews.text: This is maddening. When I got this app it was decent. Not flashy but gets the job done. Since then, every update makes it glitchier, harder to use, less effective, and just worse overall. Every time this happens it’s frustrating and makes you question the money you’re paying for the subscription but I’ve held out because so much of my workout history was already on here. But this is the last straw. The app has gone from a convenience to a liability. I’m cancelling my subscription and switching to another app.

reviews.title: Terrible app with worse support
reviews.text: Used to be great but they’ve ruined it over the years. Support is uninformed and surly. The app won’t remember my weight or my rest timer. Might as well track with pen and paper for all the good this app does

reviews.title: Please update and fix the rest time
reviews.text: The rest time keeps resetting to 45 seconds and the reps are automatically at 15 reps. Please fix.

reviews.title: Great app!
reviews.text: This app is user friendly.  Easy to use even for a beginner exerciser.   I love it and I love the flexibility it gives me to switch exercises in workouts etc!   One of the best to keep me on track

reviews.title: Such a great resource
reviews.text: I love this app, it has been so helpful in organizing my gym routine

reviews.title: Very buggy at the moment
reviews.text: With my Apple Watch it frequently looses sync, switches to the wrong exercise, looses my tracked weight and reps. It’s quite frustrating I tend to have to go back constantly to reset my numbers and get the watch to sync up. When it works the app is perfect, but 9 times out of 10 it struggles with basic tracking numbers. Wish that was fixed.

reviews.title: Helpful workout app
reviews.text: If you’re not used to lifting of familiar with the weight room then this app is for you! If you don’t have a plan or know where to start then this is the app for you.

reviews.title: Stop breaking your app!!
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app for a long time to track my lifting progress. But I’m about to leave. The app now reloads every time I try to open it, requiring an internet connection, or it infinitely loads. My gym doesn’t have service in it, meaning I can only use the app in airplane mode. 

The new AI function is forced on users. There is no way to “skip” or “exit” when it pops up. I do not need AI to help me with progressive overload.  Very patronizing. 

Every time I start a workout, my flow is interrupted by a full-screen pop up advertising the paid version of the app. I’m telling you, devs, that this user has developed so much resentment for your app because of this forced, full screen ad. 

Stop releasing changes that make the app harder to use!! Fix the small usability problems!! 

I am a UX researcher. Devs, listen to your UX team!!!!

Update Sept 2026: another update, another broken app. test your app before you release updates!!!! It is infuriating!!!!!

reviews.title: Excellent program for tracking workouts
reviews.text: Versatile tool to manage and track just about any workout routine you can think of. Great summary and reviews.

reviews.title: Not a lot of variety
reviews.text: Kind of sick of the same routine even after changing the preferences

reviews.title: Monetizing previously free features
reviews.text: Insane work to charge a subscription for features that used to be free. Never using this app again.

reviews.title: AI integration is annoying
reviews.text: Recommend set and reps by AI is not great. Wish they’d leave it as is or give the option to opt out of it.

reviews.title: Best Gym App
reviews.text: Been using this for several years now and find it the easiest to use during a workout

reviews.title: Jim
reviews.text:
Great app! I enjoy that you can have moat any exercise explained and shown, as well as, create your own routine.  Free version even let's you save routine, weights, and sets.  Elite version is even deeper, the custom routine builder is Amazing.
  I've tried other apps and have always come back to Jefit.  Thank you to the developers!!

reviews.title: Solid App
reviews.text: Library is good, UI is intuitive, customization options are good, price point is good. Devs need to add an option to pause a workout.

reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text: I can’t upload my own video, and the exercise drawing isn’t fully visible. If I want to create a custom exercise, I need the option to upload my own video and see the complete exercise illustration. Could you please add this feature

reviews.title: The best fitness app available!!!
reviews.text:
I've used this app for the past two years and I love it. My routines have not been the same once I started using it. It is very simple to use and it helps me track my progress and it keeps me honest to my goals ;)~ When I'm stuck, bored with my routine or out of workout ideas all it takes is a quick review of any muscle group and is all there, the creative juices start flowing. 

I especially like the new updates. I find them very easy to use. It did take for me to review, read and understand, duh. But after reviewing it and playing with it, it all made sense.  I just wished exercises were aligned by machine. I.e. the one leg extension should be next to the two leg program. Scrolling to find the right machine is sometimes time consuming and at the gym every minute counts, we hate losing momentum!

reviews.title: A great free workout tracker
reviews.text: This app has no ads, is completely free to use without a subscription, and is a great way to log your workouts and progressively add on more weight overtime. It’s also great to see what muscles you’re hitting and how your body. It’s a solid app!

reviews.title: Fun app!
reviews.text: I’m enjoying JeFit so far, it’s nice to have workouts set up for me so I don’t have to decide what to do but I can swap things out if I want to try something different. Also I like how it calculates progressions and has a four week cycle. I do wish I could swap the days around, like if I could make day 1 legs instead of the way it is set up. This is because I do a long run on Saturday and I don’t want to do legs the day before. But that’s minor, I can just start with day 3 and work back ways through the week. So far so good….

reviews.title: It’s frustrating
reviews.text: I purchased the year-long subscription and have used Jefit for about 3 months. It provides a very loose exercise framework that keeps me going to the gym, but the AI coach is strange — it repeats the same exercises that target specific areas but completely ignores others. For me, it’s arms: It barely adds any arm work and I have to add them in myself. Big oversight by jefit. The interface takes awhile to get used to, and I’m still figuring things out. Not sure I’ll re-up at the end of the year.

reviews.title: Newbie
reviews.text: I love this app, it keeps me accountable every morning to do my workout.

reviews.title: Good not great
reviews.text: The weight and rep recommendation doesn’t make sense based on prior week numbers, which is a big reason I purchased the app. They’re missing equipment/exercise as well and adding an exercise is limited. Overall pretty good but I wish I purchased the monthly subscription not annual as I don’t know how long I’ll use the app.

reviews.title: Top Notch PT App
reviews.text: Love this app for many years now. This has kept me on a path of self motivation to obtain any physical condition that I desire. With discipline and consistency this app will guide you to your fitness goals. 100 facts!!!!!

reviews.title: Mehmet
reviews.text: Great app. Tried many different apps, but none of them is as good as this app. Very easy to use and very good for keeping track of your workouts.

reviews.title: Wormouts and cooldowns are missing
reviews.text: Everything is great. But I’m missing wormouts and cooldows for AI driven workouts. Also, add comparability with Garmin watches and heart straps, pleeaaasssseee!!!

reviews.title: Great lifting app
reviews.text: This is a great weight lifting app for beginners or more experienced people. Using JEFIT has kept me on track for a solid 6 weeks so far.  I would recommend it to everyone.

reviews.title: Sinking on syncing
reviews.text: I have had repeated issues with syncing. My gym has poor WiFi.  When I am finished the workout it is supposed to sync. That fails. So when I go home I try everything and can to get my workout to sync so that day’s workout gets added into my history. I’ve tried every suggestion my AI gave me and still no success. Major bummer.

reviews.title: Good App but needs improvement.
reviews.text:
I get frustrated when the next time I go to the gym my weights and reps change. My work around is to save my workout out information in my notes where I save my machine settings.

I tried several other online apps similar to Jefit and they were a lot worse, so I’m staying with the devil I know rather than the other ones that have some good features but are worse overall.

reviews.title: Far from perfect
reviews.text: I have been using this app for several months and my verdict is that anyone else who would have been its successive releases would normally not have a job today. There is not A DAY that goes by without having to report a bug, from routines that do not play the appropriate illustrations and videos which CAN be a big deal and is still not fixed to the mix ups of routines from different muscle groups when you try to work solely on a certain muscle group. Before you realize that you are trying to find that one routine in vain,precious time has been lost. I have lost track of the number of times I wrote to support for this or that bug, sometimes even without an acknowledgement. One thing that also bugs me (pun intended) is that there is no clock on the personalized routine. Maybe there is one on the other routines but i don’t know . One final thing, I am not sure that going from dark blue to light blue when you select a muscle group is a wide decision. It is certainly not user friendly when people have a hard time seeing colors. Going from dark blue to white or pink any color that suits your preference would also save time, for those who are keenly time conscious. Barring some changes based on quality than rushing to release a new version without some real quality control I don’t expect to renew my subscription.

reviews.title: Amazing app
reviews.text: Love the ability to customize workouts days and have an extensive array of exercises to choose from. You can customize your rest times and intervals to keep you on track and get a warning when you’re at 5 seconds left

reviews.title: It’s okay
reviews.text: Not the best logging app, but used to be. The AI people don’t help and add a strong sense of uncanny valley when looking at them but in a real world setting, or in a position where you’re trying to compare an actual human body. Honestly if it weren’t for the AI usage I’d probably do 4 stars.

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.text: This app is probably useful for the morbidly obese. Extremely easy workouts are the norm. You may not even break a sweat unless you add something on your own.  Also has a substandard exercise base. Save your cash and look elsewhere.

reviews.title: could be great .
reviews.text: doesn’t not synch  and support  doesn’t respond .shuts down half way thru work out

reviews.title: Best workout app ever
reviews.text: I’ve been using this to track my lifts and measurements and it’s perfect for both

reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text: App used to be amazing but it seems every other update they take away a feature to try to make people pay for elite… which is fine for me but a now I can’t even share workout programs without the other person having to get elite to use it

reviews.title: Great workout tracker
reviews.text:
Free & Easy to build a workout routine for most people who are new to the gym or been going to the gym for a while but don’t track progress as much.

I’ve been going to the gym for almost 6 years now, and haven’t tracked my progress as much as I should. With this app I’ve noticed actual progress physically & from a weight lifting prospective. Would recommend!

reviews.title: We see you
reviews.text: The app is literally designed to make you frustrated with the free version and they try to upsell you every chance they get. No thanks.
